name: Physical Intelligence
summary: Physical Intelligence develops foundation models and training data for robots that learn general-purpose physical tasks.
overview: Physical Intelligence develops foundation models and training data for robots that learn general-purpose physical tasks.
bull_case: A leading technical team and an unusually large funding base can accelerate the data collection and integration needed for robotics AI.
bear_case: Commercial robotics requires expensive, slow hardware deployment and evidence of reliable performance outside the lab.

intelligence.description: Physical Intelligence develops foundation models and training data for robots that learn general-purpose physical tasks.
company: Physical Intelligence develops AI software and data systems intended to help robots learn general-purpose physical tasks.
The company raised $600 million in November 2025 at a reported $5.6 billion valuation.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Robotics AI requires capital-intensive data collection, hardware integration, and long development cycles. Physical Intelligence is a key private-market bet on whether foundation-model economics can extend from digital work into the physical world.

changed.text: Raised $600M in a Series B led by CapitalG.

takeaways: The latest disclosed round valued the company at $5.6B.
Robotics training data and hardware deployment are the core execution constraints.
Its commercial progress will test demand for general-purpose robot intelligence.
